}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "milkV" and "DUO_S_MB_V1-1" is silkscreened on board bottom. {{See also|Milk-V|List of SBCs}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: ''SophGo'' SG2000 @1.0GHz (selectable) :SoC: RISC-V C906 @700MHz (64-bit) core or :ARM (Cortex-A53), NPU: 0.5 TOPS INT8, BF16; :MCU 8051 @25-300MHz core with 8KB SRAM *Storage: TF card (max.128GB)/MMC card slot, *Memory: 512MB (DDR3) RAM (integrated SiP) *WiFi: [[AIC]] AIC8800 D40 (1T1R 802.11ax) :SDIO 3.0: Wi-Fi, UART/PCM: BT 5.4 BLE *Network: 1x Fast Ethernet (100MbE) port *USB: 1x USB 2.0 (Type-C), 1x USB 2.0 (Host) ports *GPIO: 2x 26-pin headers *Power Source: 5V via USB (Type-C) port
==Links of Interest== :[https://milkv.io/docs/duo/getting-started/duos Documentation] *[https://linuxgizmos.com/updated-milk-v-duo-s-dual-core-risc-v-sbc-open-for-pre-order-starting-at-11-00/ ''Milk-V Duo S: Dual-Core RISC-V SBC'' on '''LinuxGizmos'''] *[https://www.cnx-software.com/2024/03/25/duo-s-risc-v-arm-sbc-features-sophgo-sg2000-soc-ethernet-wifi-6-and-bluetooth-5-connectivity/ ''Duo S RISC-V/ARM SBC features SophGo SG2000 SoC'' on '''CNX-Software''']
